name: From the Moon

categories.label: Score track VP (before final count)
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track (trước kiểm điểm cuối)
categories.hint: VP gained during play: mission liftoff bonuses, buildings, immediate effects. Add +50/+100/+150/+200 tokens when lapped.

categories.label: Achievements: majority bonus
categories.hint: Enter achievement tokens held. 1st 24 VP, 2nd 12 VP; ties split sum rounded down; 2 players: only 1st place scores (24).

categories.label: Ship-part upgrades: majority bonus
categories.labelVi: Nâng cấp vỏ tàu: thưởng nhiều nhất
categories.hint: Enter number of ship-part upgrades. 1st 8 VP, 2nd 4 VP; ties split; 2 players: only 1st scores (8).

categories.label: Pairs of leftover resources
categories.hint: Enter total leftover resources; each pair of any 2 resources = 1 VP.

categories.label: Achievement tokens (1 VP each)
categories.hint: Enter the same achievement count; 1 VP each, on top of the majority bonus.

categories.label: Large building tiles (hourglass icon)
categories.labelVi: Tòa nhà lớn (biểu tượng đồng hồ cát)
categories.hint: Sum end-game VP of your large buildings per their printed condition (e.g. 3 per specialist, 2 per lab, 4 per upgraded greenhouse).

notes: family: area-majority. Game ends when someone launches the 3rd mission or moves a player marker past the last Progress track space; finish the round, then final count. Mission majority bonuses (main/secondary printed on launch tile) are scored in play at liftoff and are included in trackScore. Solo mode (needs all 3 ships launched, tiered achievement/upgrade bonuses, Bronze<150/Silver/Gold>200) not modelled. Rulebook states no tiebreaker. Reviewed from French rulebook and glossary.
